post.title: full-stack-eval-harness
post.content: GitHub Tests LLM prompts against datasets with configurable graders, runs experiments and compares results. - Prompts are markdown files in families, datasets are CSV, graders are YAML. - Graders cover faithfulness, LLM-as-judge rubrics, semantic similarity, exact-match, contains, regex and json-schema. - Prompt variants run side by side on one dataset with an A/B comparison endpoint. - RAG candidates can call different retrieval services and be graded on the same dataset.
